summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Unsubscribe and Newsletter Preferences pages. All 8 features tested and working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Both pages use proper data-testid attributes for testing
API_URL correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL environment variable
Error handling is comprehensive with success/error/not_found states
Email validation works via HTML5 native validation and custom JS check
URL parameter handling works correctly for email pre-fill
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unsubscribe and Preferences pages fully tested. All newsletter management features working correctly.

unsubscribe_page_loads.details: Page loads at /unsubscribe with header 'Unsubscribe', email input, and submit button

unsubscribe_email_validation.details: Browser native HTML5 validation shows 'Please include an @ in the email address' for invalid emails

unsubscribe_form_submission.details: Form submits successfully and shows green success message: 'Unsubscribed Successfully - If you were subscribed, you have been unsubscribed successfully'

preferences_page_loads.details: Page loads at /newsletter/preferences with header 'Email Preferences' and email input form

preferences_non_subscriber_message.details: Entering non-subscriber email (test@nonexistent.com) shows yellow 'Not Found' message with 'This email is not subscribed to our newsletter'

preferences_valid_subscriber_toggles.details: Entering valid subscriber email (news@cheshiretoday.co.uk) shows 3 toggle options: Daily Brief, Weekly Roundup, Breaking News Alerts

preferences_toggle_and_save.details: Toggling preferences enables Save button, clicking Save shows green success message: 'Preferences Saved - Your email preferences have been updated'

link_unsubscribe_to_preferences.details: Link 'Manage your email preferences instead →' navigates to /newsletter/preferences with email parameter in URL

preferences_page.not_found_message: This email is not subscribed to our newsletter
preferences_page.success_message: Your email preferences have been updated
